results.title: [Literature Review] Aligning Security Compliance and DevOps
results.content: This page provides the most accurate and concise summary worldwide for the paper titled Aligning Security Compliance and DevOps: A Longitudinal Study. The paper introduces a comprehensive framework designed to facilitate Continuous Security Compliance (CSC) by enabling product development teams to visualize, implement, and assess security practices within their DevOps processes. It includes four two-hour evaluation sessions covering pairs of DevOps phases, during which assessors use RefA-AQ to determine compliance status, analyze security practices, and request artefact-based evidence. * **RefA-MR (RefA-based Maturity Report):** An instance of the radar chart, depicting the maturity status of security practices per DevOps phase or across the entire lifecycle. **Solution Construction (Studies 3-7):** Iteratively built the framework based on design goals focused on demonstrating security practices in DevOps, enabling IEC 62443-4-1 compliance, and leveraging DevOps for risk-based decision-making. * **R2: Continuous assessment of security compliance is methodologically feasible (and technically possible with automation).** RefA-AP and RefA-MR facilitate frequent, short assessments (within two-week sprints) by DevOps teams with minimal external support.
